Summer semester 2027
7 January 2027 to 31 March 2027
NOTE: University Preparation Programme, opens an external URL in a new window: 7 January 2027 until 5 February 2027
Other important Dates and Deadlines
Deadline Continuation of Studies
Students are obliged to report to the university each semester that they are continuing their studies by paying the ÖH fee and, if applicable, the prescribed tuition fee.
All studies and co-registrations
Winter semester 2026/27
6 July 2026 to 31 October 2026
Summer semester 2027
7 January 2027 to 31 March 2027
Application deadline for Non-EU/EEA citizens
Bachelor's, master's and doctoral studies
Non-EU/EEA-citizen must submit the application for admission in complete form (with all documents and certifications) within this deadline. Otherwise, admission for the applied semester is not possible.
Winter semester 2026/27
16 January 2026 until 15 July 2026
Summer semester 2027
16 July 2026 until 15 January 2027
NOTE!
If you have an admission letter for the winter semester, you can enrol in person at the Admissions Office until 31 October If you have an admission letter for the summer semester, you can enrol in person at the Admissions Office until 31 March If supplementary examinations have been prescribed, which have to be taken in the University Preparation Programme (VWU) before admission to degree programme, you have to register for the VWU-Course latest by 13 August (winter semester) or 19 January (summer semester). Otherwise, attendance of the VWU is not possible.
Application deadline for EU/EEA citizens
Bachelor's studies
EU/EEA-citizen who do not have an equivalent secondary school-leaving certificate must submit the application for admission in complete form (with all documents and certifications) within this deadline. Otherwise, admission for the applied semester is not possible.
Winter semester 2026/27
Beginning of February 2026 until end of July 2026
Summer semester 2027
Beginning of August 2026 until end of January 2027
Master's and doctoral studies
EU/EEA-citizen must submit the application for admission in complete form (with all documents and certifications) within this deadline. Otherwise, admission for the applied semester is not possible.
Winter semester 2026/27
Beginning of February 2026 until end of July 2026
Summer semester 2027
Beginning of August 2026 until end of January 2027
NOTE!
If you have an admission letter for the winter semester, you can enrol in person at the Admissions Office until 31 October If you have an admission letter for the summer semester, you can enrol in person at the Admissions Office until 31 March If supplementary examinations have been prescribed, which have to be taken in the University Preparation Programme (VWU) before admission to degree programme, you have to register for the VWU-Course latest by 13 August (winter semester) or 19 January (summer semester). Otherwise, attendance of the VWU is not possible.
Classification of the Academic Year
Winter semester 2026/27:
Thursday, 01 October 2026 to Sunday, 28 February 2027
Summer semester 2027:
Monday, 01 March 2027 to Thursday, 30 September 2027
Recess Period
All Soul's Day: Monday, 2 November 2026
Christmas Holidays: Monday, 21 December 2026 to Wednesday, 6 January 2027
Winter Break: Friday, 29 January 2027 to Sunday, 28 February 2027
Easter Holidays: Monday, 22 March 2027 to Sunday, 4 April 2027
Whitsun Holidays: Tuesday, 18 May 2027
Rector's day: Friday, 28 May 2027
Summer Break: Thursday, 1 July 2027 to Thursday, 30 September 2027
